topics.title: Gary’s Bachelor Date and Radio Host Interactions
topics.summary: Bachelor No. 7, Gary the producer, describes his date package including sitting in on Howard Stern’s last hour of the show and a double date with Jackie at the Friars Club followed by an assistant. During the broadcast, there are interruptions from other radio hosts like Larry King discussing ratings and audience size, as well as tangents about celebrity behavior and boycotts.””

topics.title: Listener Obsession & Radio Ratings
topics.summary: Howard and his guest discuss listener obsession with Larry King’s show ratings, joking about callers becoming addicted to hearing him. They highlight bizarre demands from listeners including legal action over prank calls, showcasing a strange fascination within the audience while discussing potential revenue streams.

topics.title: Ex-Mayor’s Stuffed Animal Party
topics.summary: An ex-mayor plans a New Year’s party for his stuffed animal guests, including musical performers like ‘Joe Mater, the mojo maker,’ and references to suggestive nicknames. The conversation becomes chaotic as he discusses entertainment options such as 'Homo no mo' and obscure candy references with other attendees.

topics.title: Celebrity Tax Evasion & Jail Conditions
topics.summary: The broadcast centers on Leona Smith’s conviction for tax evasion, with participants debating the severity of her sentence alongside discussions about potential jail conditions like solitary confinement and diaper-changing duties. The conversation then shifts to Harry's health issues, Gary's opinions, and various celebrity controversies including accusations against Harry and a discussion regarding AIDS babies.

topics.title: Mayor’s Barbie Obsession and Mental Confusion
topics.summary: During an interview, the mayor expresses confusion about city finances while obsessing over a new line of Barbie dolls he purchased for his daughters. He makes bizarre statements regarding taxes, Spanish help, prison guards, and repeatedly demands that they be handled with care, culminating in a discussion of his children’s appearance.

topics.title: Philadelphia Luncheon & Barbie Doll Chaos
topics.summary: During a radio show, Howard discusses a luncheon in Philadelphia and his attempts to adopt a more masculine voice while introducing Uncle Richard Simmons and Robin. The conversation becomes chaotic as they discuss weight loss, personal relationships, and an obsession with a Golden Edition Barbie doll featuring a 'crack addicted baby' figure.
